title: Bike Brooklyn NYC Like a Local by Original NYC
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please contact Original NYC directly for questions/concerns about accessibility using the contact information on this page.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the genuine NYC on this fun and easy guided bike tour. Our friendly and knowledgeable guides will take and guide you through some of the most vibrant areas of the city including places only true New Yorkers know about. You'll bike through Brooklyn along rarely traveled routes with the most spectacular views of NYC & its iconic landmarks while showcasing the distinct personality of the city we call home. With entertaining insight and stunning photos in hand, you’ll leave the tour an NYC original yourself.

New York City attracts millions of travelers each year for its style, iconic history and hub of modernity. But let’s face it - it’s filled with head spinning crowds and tourist traps, not to mention plenty of tour companies eager to take your money in exchange for a cookie-cutter experience. Original NYC is not like the others.
